views.name: monthly_account_changes
views.body_sql: SELECT customer_id AS customer, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month, SUM(txn_amount) AS monthly_change FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
views.description: aggregates raw account activity to compute net monthly change per customer

views.name: customer_month_balance_sequence
views.body_sql: SELECT customer, month, monthly_change, COALESCE(SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer ORDER BY month), 0) AS cumulative_balance FROM monthly_account_changes
views.description: expands to full calendar months per customer, joins with changes, carries forward balances, and computes cumulative totals
